fichas.title: Petrol Stations
fichas.summary: Petrol stations combine fuel and lubricant dispensing with maintenance, vehicle-care and often retail services. Design considerations include applicable water, fire and flammable-liquid regulations; vehicle and queuing space; pump-island layouts; liquid-impervious paving and drainage; impact protection for pumps; and special provisions for LPG. Figures show dispenser types, minimum pump-island layouts, self-service arrangements, and service points for oil, air and water.
